rev.t: Corner House is definitely one of my personal favourite places in Bangalore. Whether it’s a quick visit for an ice cream craving or simply ending the day with a delicious ice cream, it has always been one of my go-to places. 🍦❤️ …

The Corner House, locals flock to this iconic dessert joint all year round.
Their Death By Chocolate is one of the best desserts I had, it’s a generous serving of chocolate/vanilla ice cream with berries/nuts & hot chocolate fudge. …

Pure chocolate bliss. 🍫 Loaded with fudge, ice cream, and enough roasted nuts to make every bite crunch. The quality and taste were a solid 10/10. Great quality, hearty portion size, and incredible flavor. …
